name: Mindless
description: Powers affecting the mind have no effect on [NAME]. They cannot be reasoned with, are unaffected by morale, and will never flee.

name: Brains!
description: [NAME] will prioritize attacking Incapacitated targets using their Bite attack. If a target dies this way, they will rise as a Zombie in 3 hours.

name: Critical Mass
description: When [NAME]'s HP reaches 0, its body explodes in a violent spray of acidic viscera and fluids. Anyone ADJACENT to [NAME] when it dies takes 1d6+3 Corrosive damage.

name: Incorporeal
description: [NAME] suffers half damage from all Physical attacks it receives. [NAME] is also able to pass through solid objects unhindered.

name: Floating
description: [NAME] floats half a meter off the ground at all times. All Provoked Attacks made against [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Frost Resistance
description: [NAME] has +5 Frost Resistance.

name: Divine Weakness
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Divine damage.

name: Possess
description: Standard. [NAME] passes into a living being that is ADJACENT to it. The target must perform a MR check vs. TN 17. Failure results in the target becoming Confused (TN 18) and [NAME] disappearing into the target's body. Lasts 3 rounds or until the target suffers 18 or more damage in a single attack. While possessed, [NAME] is immune to damage. A [NAME] can only possess once per battle.

name: Horrifying Visage
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME]'s face changes into the stuff of nightmares for a moment. The target is Stunned if they are unable to resist their fear.

name: Embrace of the Grave
description: Quick. On a successful Icy Touch, [NAME] grabs its victim and bites into them deeply. A numbing chill freezes the victim's veins and leaves a lingering weakness inside of them. The target must make a MIGHT check against a TN of 15 or become Diseased. Embrace of the Grave reduces MIGHT by -2 and is contagious.

name: Fear Aura
description: Any character starting their turn ADJACENT to [NAME] must roll 2d10+MR against a TN of 14 or be Hindered for 1 round.

name: Gaze of the Night
description: Standard. Nearby. [NAME] pierces its target with a mesmerizing glare. The target must perform a MR check vs. TN of 18. Failure results in them believing they are fighting a weaker version of the real [NAME]; in reality their body grows limp and their eyes become empty. The illusion has 20 HP and deals damage just like the real [NAME]. Defeating the illusion causes the target to become Incapacitated and unable to perform Death rolls. Only an Ally can stabilize and wake them. Allies physically ADJACENT to the affected target may rally them as a Quick action, granting +1 to all their rolls (stacks).

name: Sweeping Strike
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] performs a massive flourish with its curved claws, striking all ADJACENT targets for 3d10+10 damage.

name: Shadow Form
description: Movement. [NAME] is able to move without suffering Provoked Attacks. For an additional 1 Ruin, [NAME] may move up to a FAR distance instead of NEARBY.

name: Unholy Frenzy
description: Quick. Nearby. Allow a single Undead ally to perform another Standard action.

name: Come Hither
description: Quick. Nearby. [NAME] attempts to beckon its target to him. The target must perform a MR check vs. TN 16. If the target fails, it moves one range band closer towards [NAME] even if it doesn't have a Movement action left. The target is vulnerable to Provoked Attacks during Come Hither.

name: Unholy Regeneration
description: [NAME] regenerates 15 HP at the start of his turn each round. If he suffered Divine damage in the previous round, Unholy Regeneration is nullified this round.

name: Sunlight Vulnerability
description: If [NAME] starts a turn in direct sunlight, it instantly suffers 40 Fire damage.

name: Divine Weakness
description: [NAME] takes 1.5 times more damage from Divine damage.

name: Dark Inevitability
description: Every time [NAME] misses an attack, its AR increases temporarily by +1 (stacking) until a successful attack lands.

name: Unquenchable Thirst
description: Once per battle, [NAME]'s Bite Attack is particularly brutal and will deal maximum damage.

name: Blood Sense
description: [NAME] can smell the blood and hear the heartbeats of living creatures within 200m. Unless one can mask either of these features, there is no hiding from [NAME].

name: My Precious
description: If [NAME] is fighting within 200m of where its heart is being kept, all of its power costs are reduced by 1 Ruin, effectively making its 1-Ruin powers free.

name: Backstab
description: When attacking a target that has any of [NAME]'s allies ADJACENT to it, [NAME] deals an additional 1d6 damage. Only works for melee attacks.

name: Disable
description: Standard. A quick, yet crippling jab to a vital spot of the target that deals 1d8 damage and disables the target from using powers for 1 round.

name: Shimmer
description: Reaction. Combining their speed with fine-tuned mechanized control, [NAME] is able to vibrate intensely and become difficult to hit. Can be activated when an attack is about to be made against [NAME]. Causes the attacker to suffer Hindrance on that attack.

name: Hustle
description: [NAME]'s diminutive size and fast legs make it an annoying target to hit. All Provoked Attacks made against [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Hamstring
description: Standard. [NAME] lashes out at its target's legs attempting to diminish their ability to move. On a successful hit, the target suffers 1d8+4 damage and is Rooted for 1 round.

name: Blur
description: Quick. [NAME] becomes difficult to see and causes Hindrance on all attacks made against it until the start of its next turn.

name: Fireball
description: Standard. Ranged. A ball of fire sails through the air towards its target. A successful hit causes it to explode, dealing 2d4+3 Fire damage to the target and anyone ADJACENT to it that fails their Defense roll.

name: Make It Rain
description: Standard. [NAME] unleashes a barrage of bombs into the air that are aimed at all its enemies on the battlefield. All enemy targets that do not move from their current location by the start of [NAME]'s next turn suffer 1d8+2 Fire damage.

name: Short Fuse
description: If an attack successfully strikes [NAME], the attacking player rolls 1d10 before rolling damage: 1–6: Roll attack damage as normal. 7–8: One of the bombs [NAME] is carrying gets knocked to the ground and set off. [NAME] capitalizes on this using the explosion to launch itself up in the air to land within a FAR distance (GM's choice). 9–10: The attack sets off a bomb in [NAME]'s pack and it explodes, dealing 2d6 Fire damage to itself and everyone ADJACENT to it.

name: Berserker Rage
description: Quick. [NAME] enters an intense rage and gains +5 damage and +5 Damage Resistance but suffers -3 DR for 1 round.

name: Cleave
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] swings in a wide arc and slices through two targets for 2d6+8 damage.

name: Savage Inspiration
description: In the presence of [NAME], all Orcs on the battlefield regenerate 5 HP per round at the start of their turn. [NAME] does not gain this benefit.

name: Toxic Spray
description: Standard. Ranged. Nearby. (Toxic Beetle only.) A green spray of deadly juices erupts from [NAME]'s mouth. The target immediately suffers 2d6 Corrosive damage and is Poisoned (1d10 True damage at TN 16) for 3 rounds.

name: Combustion
description: Standard. (Fire Beetle only.) [NAME]'s belly begins to glow like a blazing ember as it expands. At the start of [NAME]'s next turn, all units ADJACENT to it will automatically suffer 2d6 Fire damage. Striking [NAME] while it is charging up its Combustion will also cause it to explode for 2d6 Fire damage.

name: A Thousand Stings
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. [NAME]'s elytra (hardened forewings) open up and unleash a swarm of tiny flying gnats that descend upon the target. MR check vs TN 18. If the target fails its check, it suffers 1d10+10 damage and is unable to use powers on its next turn.

name: March for the Queen
description: Quick. Ranged. Far. [NAME] lets out a series of high pitched noises followed by several clicks in the direction of another Carapid. The targeted Carapid has their Movement action renewed.

name: Soothing Presence
description: At the start of [NAME]'s turn, any ADJACENT Carapid allies are healed for 5 HP.

name: Pincer Bite
description: Standard. [NAME] uses its powerful mandibles to crush its target and hold it in place. The target suffers 1d10+5 damage and must remain ADJACENT to [NAME] for 2 rounds. The target may Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT at the beginning of its turn to see if it can break free. If [NAME] moves while its target is successfully pincered, the target moves with it and suffers Provoked Attacks if applicable.

name: Formic Fever
description: Quick. On a successful Pincer Bite, [NAME] may secrete a deadly toxin that causes a contagious Disease in the target if they fail a MIGHT check against a TN of 15. The target suffers -1 to MIGHT and AGILITY.

name: Burrowed
description: [NAME] is often burrowed in the ground, laying in wait for prey to ambush. If [NAME] starts Burrowed, note their location on the battlefield. They may spring up at any time during the fight but will use that round emerging from the ground only, allowing players a chance to react.

name: Tail Swipe
description: Standard. [NAME] snaps its torso quickly and brings its tail around to strike all enemies that are ADJACENT to it. Enemies that are successfully struck suffer 1d6+4 damage.

name: Consume Essence
description: Standard. [NAME] drops onto a dead target or fallen organic entity (friend or foe) to Consume their Essence. A successful Bite must have been made against the target first. While consuming, [NAME] is vulnerable and any attacks made against it gain +2 to attack. [NAME] receives a bonus to its next turn upon successfully consuming. Devoured targets fully complete their Consumed Essence by the start of [NAME]'s next turn and receive a bonus to its next turn's Essence.

name: Lifedrinker
description: [NAME]'s attacks are empowered to siphon life and heal either [NAME] or its allies. When [NAME] deals damage, a single friendly demonic target up to FAR away will be healed for half the amount of that damage.

name: Fell Swap
description: Movement. Far. [NAME] may physically swap places with another demonic ally. Does not cause Provoked Attacks.

name: Fell Lash
description: Standard. Ranged. Nearby. Both of [NAME]'s hands set ablaze with purple fire. [NAME] performs a quick snapping motion one hand after another, sending tendrils of purple flame towards its targets. Strike 2 different targets up to a NEARBY distance for 1d10+4 Fire damage each.

name: Visions from the Void
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. [NAME] assaults the target's mind with terrifying visions causing them to lose their Movement action as they move to a NEARBY location of the GM's choosing.

name: Void Sickness
description: Standard. Ranged. Far. Once per battle, [NAME] is able to send a creeping miasma towards one target on the battlefield. The miasma moves at one range band per round. If it reaches its target, the target must make a MIGHT check against a TN of 16 or become Diseased. Void Sickness reduces MIND by -1. The miasma stops only when [NAME] dies.

name: Puppet Master
description: [NAME] gains full control of any target it slays. The puppet acts as another combatant on the field, possessing all its abilities and stats prior to having its soul devoured. The puppet has half of its max HP.

name: Devour Soul
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] consumes a puppet and heals for 20 HP.

name: Mind Blast
description: Quick. Nearby. Targets MR. Deal 1d10 True damage. Target is Stunned for 1 round.

name: Tentacle Strikes
description: [NAME] attacks with its tentacles and receives multiple attacks per turn. At full health [NAME] receives 4 total attacks per turn using Tentacle Strike (4). [NAME] may attack the same target 4 times or spread the attacks around. For every 25% or 75 HP [NAME] is missing, it loses an attack per round and uses the corresponding Tentacle Strike (#) guideline for attacks and damage. As it is damaged, [NAME]'s attacks grow more desperate but lessen in quantity.

name: Devour
description: Quick. Nearby. When [NAME] Incapacitates a target it may choose to Devour it. A Devoured target is considered stabilized but unreachable to their Allies unless they kill [NAME] and break open its digestive sac. Upon Devouring a target, [NAME] is healed for 30 HP and will begin regenerating 5 HP per round for each target Devoured during the battle. Devoured targets will die in four days if not rescued and lose 25% of their HP each day.

name: Tentacle Fling
description: Quick. Nearby. On a successful Tentacle Strike, [NAME] may displace its target a FAR distance from where [NAME] is currently located. Contest MIGHT vs. MIGHT to resist displacement.

name: Aura of Dread
description: Any character starting their turn ADJACENT to [NAME] must roll 2d10+MR against a TN of 12 or suffer -2 to AR for 1 round.

name: Keen Senses
description: All Stealth checks suffer Hindrance when done within 20m of [NAME].

name: Flail
description: Standard. [NAME] flails all of its tentacles in random directions all around itself. Everyone who is ADJACENT or NEARBY must make a Defense roll. Those that are successfully struck suffer 1d20+5 damage and are Staggered for 1 round.

name: Demonic Regeneration
description: [NAME] will regenerate 8 HP at the beginning of its turn each round.

name: Succumb to Madness
description: When [NAME] drops to 0 or below HP, it loses its mind and goes berserk for one last desperate attack, striking out at everyone around it. [NAME] performs an attack that hits all ADJACENT enemies for 1d10+4 damage if they fail their Defense roll.

name: Demonic Regeneration
description: [NAME] will regenerate 10 HP at the beginning of its turn each round.

name: Tentacle Swipe
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] swings its massive tentacle arm around and attempts to strike all ADJACENT enemies for its Melee Attack damage.

name: Pincer Claw
description: Standard. Adjacent. Grab an ADJACENT target and crush them with your Pincer Claw for 1d8+8 damage. They are unable to use their Movement action or make Provoked Attacks while pincered. The target may Contest MIGHT vs MIGHT to break out on their turn. Should your target start their turn while pincered, they will suffer another 1d8+8 damage automatically. Targets not taken up by your Standard action do not automatically start their turn pincered. Can be forcibly cancelled by powers that disable or interrupt grabs (e.g. Insect Swarm, Grasp of Tala'zim, etc.).

name: Fell Pox
description: Upon death, [NAME] will vomit up a thick and viscous black ichor on an ADJACENT target (usually the one who dealt the killing blow). If the target fails their Defense roll, they must make a MIGHT check against a TN of 16 or become Diseased. Fell Pox reduces their PRESENCE and AGILITY by 2 and is contagious.

name: Prayer
description: Standard. [NAME] places her hands together and begins to chant a Prayer. A golden aura emanates from her and begins to grow. If Prayer is not interrupted by the start of her next turn, up to 3 of her allies on the battlefield are healed for 10 HP each.

name: Might of the Maker
description: Standard. Far. Place a bonus on a single ally, granting them +5 damage on their next attack. The recipient of the bonus grows noticeably larger as their muscles are engorged temporarily.

name: Light of the Maker
description: Standard. Far. Instantly heal an ally or self for 20 HP.

name: Dive Bomb
description: Standard. [NAME] forgoes its Standard action and spends its turn getting into a crouch to launch itself into the sky. Its DR is increased by +2 as it prepares to jump. At the start of its next turn, [NAME] uses its Standard action again and leaps up high and comes crashing down on its target (any target on the battlefield). This leap is immune to all Provoked Attacks. [NAME] receives +2 to its AR and deals 2d8+4 damage if the Dive Bomb successfully hits.

name: Soar
description: Provoked Attacks against [NAME] when it moves away from its enemies suffer Hindrance.

name: Augment
description: Quick. Target a single ADJACENT automaton. The targeted automaton receives +2 to damage, AR and DR. The bonus continues to passively increase by +1 with each round until the Scrapbot is destroyed or no longer ADJACENT to the Augmented automaton. A Scrapbot can only Augment one automaton at a time and an automaton can only be Augmented by one Scrapbot at a time.

name: Caution
description: [NAME] receives +3 DR against the first attack it receives in a battle.

name: Repair
description: Standard. Target a single ADJACENT automaton. The targeted automaton is healed for 15 HP.

name: Synchronized Retreat
description: When Gideons synchronize their movements with each other, they become a wall of steel and make it very hard for blows to slip past their defenses. When two or more Gideons move away from an enemy at the same time, their DR against a Provoked Attack is increased by +4 for that Movement.

name: Turbine Strike
description: Standard. Spend 1 round to spin up [NAME]'s weapon arm to high speeds. All attacks made afterwards drill through and ignore AV. Any damage sustained during the wind-up phase cancels the Turbine Strike. Once fully activated, Turbine Strike remains on for the rest of the battle. Must telegraph the wind up to players.

name: Mob Rule
description: For every [NAME] on the battlefield, increase [NAME] damage by +1.

name: The Last Laugh
description: When [NAME] suffers a killing blow, they make an instant Melee Attack at an ADJACENT target before they die.

name: Marks of the Infernal Kings
description: A [NAME] may only bear one mark from this list. Mark of Vorath: Quick. 1 Ruin. The [NAME]'s next attack is empowered by the hunger of the Devourer himself. [NAME] is healed for twice the amount of damage they inflict on this attack. Mark of Irathmus: Passive. The fires of Irathmus burn inside [NAME]. When [NAME]'s flesh is too weak to contain it anymore, it bursts in a fiery explosion. When [NAME] dies, anyone ADJACENT automatically suffers 1d8 Fire damage. Replaces The Last Laugh. Mark of Tala'zim: Passive. [NAME] revels in the pain of others and is invigorated by their downfall. When a PC becomes Incapacitated, [NAME] is healed for 10 HP and regains their Standard action.

name: Toughness
description: [NAME] uses its AV as universal Damage Resistance. Any type of damage (aside from True damage) it takes is reduced by its AV.

name: Eye Vulnerability
description: A [NAME]'s eye is its most precious organ. Striking the eye directly will deal 1.5x damage. The DR of the eye is 23.

name: Eye Beam — Frost
description: Standard. Far. A frosty blue beam shoots forth from [NAME]'s eye and freezes its target in place, Rooting it for 1 round and dealing 2d8+8 Frost damage.

name: Eye Beam — Fire
description: Standard. Far. A sizzling red beam shoots forth from [NAME]'s eye and sets its target and those around it ablaze. Deal 1d12+8 Fire damage to the target and any enemies ADJACENT to it that fail their Defense roll.

name: Eye Beam — Concussive
description: Standard. Far. A shimmering purple beam shoots forth from [NAME]'s eye and blasts its target with concussive force. Deal 1d12+10 damage and displace the target 1 range band away from where it was.

name: Eye Beam — Crystallize
description: Standard. Far. A bright white beam shoots forth from [NAME]'s eye and petrifies its target. If successfully struck, the target must overcome a MIGHT check against a TN of 13 or they are turned to stone. For every 25% HP the target is missing, the TN they must roll against is increased by +2. Victims petrified this way remain statues until the responsible [NAME] is slain.

name: Natural Growth
description: [NAME] regenerates 20 HP at the beginning of its turn. If there is sunlight or rain affecting [NAME], this amount is increased by +10.

name: Fire Weakness
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Fire-based damage. When [NAME] suffers Fire damage, its Natural Growth ability is disabled at the start of its next turn.

name: Power Stomp
description: Standard. Raising one massive leg off the ground, [NAME] stomps down with such force it sucks in energy. Deals 1d8+5 damage to all enemies up to a NEARBY distance away and displaces all enemies up to a NEARBY distance away to become ADJACENT to [NAME].

name: Thorny Brambles
description: Quick. Razor-sharp thorns burst forth from every part of [NAME]'s wooden body. While Thorny Brambles is active, melee attacks against [NAME] return 1d10 damage back at the attacker. Also grants +3 Armour Penetration. Lasts until the start of [NAME]'s next turn.

name: Corrosive Chomp
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] bites viciously into its target, releasing a corrosive toxin through special glands in its mouth. Deal 1d20+4 damage immediately and the target is Poisoned (1d12 True damage at TN 17) for 3 rounds.

name: Oily Secretions
description: Quick. The dorsal fin on [NAME] expands fully as a thick and slimy secretion with a pungent odour oozes forth all over [NAME]'s body. [NAME] receives +4 DR against all Melee attacks until the start of its next turn.

name: Swarm!
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] attempts to jump and wrap its limbs around its target. If successful, [NAME] releases a potent dose of pheromones onto the target that whip all the [NAME]s on the battlefield into a frenzy, increasing their damage against the target by +4 for 1 round.

name: Like a Fish
description: When fighting underwater or in areas where the water is at least 1m high, [NAME]'s Movement action carries it two range bands instead of one and Provoked Attacks against it also suffer Hindrance.

name: Pounce
description: Standard. Nearby Only. [NAME] crouches low before launching itself through the air and descending viciously on its target. Deals 1d12+15 damage. Ignores all Provoked Attacks while Pouncing.

name: Firehide
description: Damage all ADJACENT enemies for 4 Fire damage when struck with a melee attack.

name: Meltdown
description: When [NAME] is struck by a killing blow its body begins to twist and jerk as veins of fiery magma glow across its swelling skin. Uncontrollable fire from deep inside [NAME] begins to expand, signaling an imminent explosion. At the start of its next turn, [NAME] explodes (and dies) and deals 1d10+5 Fire damage to all ADJACENT targets. While Meltdown is occurring, the dying [NAME] can still be forcibly moved using Displacement powers.

name: Uncanny Smell
description: [NAME] has a keen sense of smell that allows it to track with precision and never be surprised. It is immune to any attacks or powers that require distraction or surprise to work. [NAME] is also able to detect creatures that are hiding or employing stealth up to a VERY FAR distance.

name: Fire Immunity
description: [NAME] is immune to all Fire based damage.

name: Frost Weakness
description: [NAME] takes 2x more Frost based damage.

name: Flying
description: [NAME] is immune to Provoked Attacks.

name: Shriek
description: Standard. Nearby. An ear-piercing scream originates from [NAME]'s mouth and rips through the air, disorienting its target and those ADJACENT to it. The target and those ADJACENT to it must perform a successful MR check against a TN of 14 or become Staggered. When used on a target that is ADJACENT, failure on the MR check results in the target(s) suffering an additional 1d8+4 damage on top of being Staggered.

name: Demonic Mending
description: Quick. Adjacent. Fell energies painfully cauterize wounds or twist broken bones back into place. Instantly heal the target for 20 HP.

name: Scurry
description: Reaction. When a melee attack misses [NAME], it can freely move to a NEARBY distance without Provoking any attacks.

name: Opportunist
description: [NAME] will taunt and skitter about to distract their foes, creating openings for their brethren to capitalize on. [NAME] gains +1 to AR and damage against its target for every additional [NAME] that is ADJACENT to the target.

name: Tail Whip
description: Standard. Adjacent. Some [NAME]s keep their tail concealed under clothing or armour but will use the appendage to surprise attack an unsuspecting enemy. Deals 1d4+3 damage and causes the target to be Staggered for 1 round.

name: Ambushers
description: [NAME] is adept at avoiding detection in order to always strike first. Attempts to detect lurking [NAME] suffer Hindrance.

name: Marked
description: Quick. [NAME] will communicate and wisely bring all their firepower to bear on high priority targets first. Marking a target causes a red symbol to appear above them. Marked targets suffer an additional +3 damage when successfully attacked by a [NAME]. Only one target can be marked at a time. Lasts until the end of battle.

name: Disengage
description: Movement. Using their incredible speed, [NAME] is able to move through and away from enemies without causing Provoked Attacks.

name: Desperate Shot
description: Standard. A powerful shot that deals 2d6+5 damage but breaks [NAME]'s longbow, leaving it only able to attack in melee.

name: Separation Anxiety
description: If the Rikkisian rider is killed while [NAME] is still alive, [NAME] will fly into a fit of rage and become immune to all forms of status effects and receive an extra +1d12 on its damage rolls. [NAME] will single-mindedly chase its rider's killer for vengeance and the only thing that can stop it is death.

name: Bite
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] chomps on its target and clamps down, hindering further movement. The target suffers 1d10+4 damage and is Rooted for 1 round.

name: Fell Pack
description: When attacking a target that has another [NAME] ADJACENT to it, add +1 to AR and damage for each other [NAME] ADJACENT to the target.

name: Protect Master
description: Reaction. When ADJACENT to a Vorathian Overseer, [NAME] may jump in to intercept a successful attack directed at the Overseer and take the hit instead.

name: Fear the Whip
description: Quick. Nearby. [NAME]'s Whip turns a crimson red as he snaps it across the back of one of the Imps. The lashing leaves a red hot mark on the Imp's back and the Imp begins to grow, muscles engorging as its skin tears to accommodate its new size. The targeted Imp gains +3 to AR and damage until the end of the battle. This bonus can stack indefinitely.

name: Hurry Up!
description: Standard. Far. [NAME] barks an order at one of its Imps with urgency and the promise of pain if the Imp doesn't follow through. The targeted Imp may take another Standard action if it already has one. If it has not taken its Standard action yet, it can now take 2 Standard actions for its turn. Must be used or the bonus is lost when the round ends.

name: Chariot Slam
description: Standard. Nearby. The chariot carrying [NAME] begins to hum as it prepares to slam into a target brutally and knock them back. Takes 1 round to prepare. Target takes 3d10+10 damage and is knocked back a NEARBY distance from where it was standing.

name: Riot
description: Standard. [NAME] lets out a bellowing roar that riles up all the Imps on the battlefield. All Imps receive the Hurry Up! bonus.

name: Swallow Whole
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] will attempt to swallow a Medium-sized or smaller creature whole. If successful, the creature will suffer 1d12+10 Corrosive damage immediately and each round it begins still trapped inside [NAME]. The creature will not be able to use its Movement action. The swallowed creature may attempt to attack from the inside, where [NAME] has an AV of 0. If they manage to deal 30 or more total damage from the inside, they will free themselves by bursting out of [NAME]'s side, after which [NAME] suffers an additional 15 True damage. [NAME] can only swallow one creature at a time. If the swallowed creature dies while inside [NAME], [NAME] is healed for 40 HP.

name: Body Slam
description: Standard. Adjacent. [NAME] slams its large and heavy body into all ADJACENT enemies, dealing 1d8+12 damage.

name: Corrosive Spit
description: Standard. Ranged. Very Far. A stream of green saliva is ejected forcefully at a target. The saliva sizzles as its acid burns through whatever it hits. Deals 1d8+7 Corrosive damage and reduces the AV of the target by 2 until the end of battle. AV reduction effect stacks.

name: Tremor Sense
description: [NAME] can detect any creature that physically moves on the sand within 2 km of it. No amount of stealth or sneaking around can negate Tremor Sense as long as they are touching the sands.

name: Vulnerability
description: When [NAME] uses Mandible Crush or Swallow Whole, its AV drops to 0 for the first successful attack made against it afterwards as its head becomes vulnerable for a moment.
